description: Canonical language policy for Beacon artifacts. Human-facing materials default to Chinese; machine-facing artifacts default to English or machine-stable keys.

default_policy.rule: Do not rename machine-stable keys for presentation-only localization.

human_requirement_docs.notes: Default Chinese for human-readable planning, requirement, and navigation materials.

machine_contracts.notes: Prefer stable English keys and machine-friendly structures.

human_mirrors_of_machine_contracts.notes: Chinese mirrors of machine-readable contracts; source machine artifacts are projection/evidence read models, not requirement truth.

rules: Human-facing planning and requirement materials should default to Chinese.
Machine-facing contracts and runtime artifacts should default to English or machine-stable keys.
Localization must not change machine field names.
Any new mirrored artifact type must define source JSON, Chinese mirror markdown, render function, and drift test.
